description: Visitor, visit and pageview counts (integers) for today, yesterday, the last 7 days and the 7 days before that, for one Cookie Free Analytics site. Use it for questions like ‘How many visitors did I have yesterday?’, ‘How is traffic today?’ or a weekly visits summary (compare last_7d with previous_7d). Days follow the site’s timezone, which is returned. site_id is optional and defaults to your first site. Read-only. Available on Hobby (free) and paid plans.

site_id.description: Optional site UUID. Defaults to your first site. list_sites and add_website return this id.

name: get_traffic_pulse
title: Traffic pulse
